g.text: Record attendance, payments and advances. Every entry is reviewed by the helper, and only confirmed entries reach the official balance.
The employer records entries. The helper confirms or disputes them.
1 helper with confirmed balance · Ready for payout
1 disputed cash entry · Kept strictly off shared balance
Net payable = confirmed work + confirmed bonuses − confirmed payments − confirmed advances. Pending and disputed entries are shown separately and never counted until confirmed.
